info.name: Ecommerce API - Master Collection
info.description: Master Postman collection for end-to-end business logic testing of the Ecommerce API. Maintained automatically by the development team and agy agent whenever endpoints are created or modified.

item.name: 1. Authentication & Users
item.description: User registration, email/SMS OTP verification, JWT login, token refresh, and user profile management.

request.description: Registers a new user account and triggers OTP dispatch for verification.
Sends a 6-digit one-time verification code to the user's email address via SMTP.
Verifies the received OTP code and returns JWT access and refresh tokens.
Authenticates user credentials and issues JWT token pair.
Refreshes an expired JWT access token using the valid refresh token.
Retrieves the authenticated user's profile details.

item.name: 2. Products & Categories
item.description: Catalog endpoints for browsing categories tree, brand directory, filtering products with dynamic attributes, stock verification, search suggestions, and featured collections.

request.description: Retrieves full hierarchical category tree starting from top-level root categories with nested children.
Retrieves single category detail with breadcrumb path, immediate active children, and products count.

query.description: Optional search term to filter brands by name

request.description: Lists all active brands with logo, website, and products count.
Retrieves detailed information for a specific brand by slug.

query.description: Filter by category slug (matches category and all recursive descendants)
Filter by brand slug (or comma-separated slugs e.g. apple,dell)
Filter products with effective price >= min_price
Filter products with effective price <= max_price
Filter products with active inventory available (true/false)
Full-text search across product name, description, brand, variant SKU
Number of items per page (up to max 100)

request.description: Lists catalog products with comprehensive filtering, price range, stock verification, and pagination.
Retrieves complete product page data: variants, media gallery, dynamic attributes matrix, breadcrumbs, and default variant.
Retrieves specific variant information, real-time stock availability, attributes, and discount pricing.

query.description: Optional category slug to get scoped facet options

request.description: Returns dynamic filter facets: available brands, subcategories, price range, and dynamic attribute options with counts.
Instant autocomplete suggestions returning top matching products, categories, and brands.
Retrieves collections of featured products including new arrivals and on-sale items.

item.name: 3. Cart & Items
item.description: Shopping Cart APIs: Lifecycle management, guest and authenticated sessions, inventory validation, price change detection, and cart merging.

request.description: Retrieves the customer's active shopping cart with all variant items, monetary totals, applied discounts, and real-time alerts.
Returns lightweight summary (total item count, distinct SKU count, total price) designed for navbar badges and mobile header counters.
Adds a specific product variant (SKU) to the cart or increments existing quantity with real-time stock validation.
Updates the exact quantity of a specific cart item and recalculates subtotal and total prices.
Completely removes a variant line item from the shopping cart and returns updated cart state.
Removes all items from the customer's active shopping cart.

item.name: Merge Guest Cart to User Cart

request.description: Merges an anonymous guest session cart into the authenticated customer's primary cart after sign in or sign up.

item.name: 4. Orders & Checkout
item.description: Order placement, checkout preview, coupon validation, order history, order details, cancellation, tracking timeline, invoice, and admin management.

request.description: Precomputes subtotal, delivery fee, coupon discounts, stock availability, and line items before final order placement.
Validates promo coupon voucher against user limits, expiration, and order subtotal.

request.description: Converts customer's active cart into an immutable order with stock reservation.
Lists past orders placed by authenticated user with status filters and pagination.
Retrieves itemized breakdown, address, items, and status history of an order.
Cancels an order and automatically releases reserved inventory stock.
Chronological milestones, courier tracking number, and delivery status.
Itemized billing summary, address details, and financial totals for invoicing.
Staff administrator view to search, filter, and inspect all customer orders.
Staff administrator endpoint to progress lifecycle state, assign tracking, and log notes.
Staff administrator endpoint to record internal notes visible only to employees.

item.name: 5. Reviews & Ratings
item.description: Customer reviews and star ratings for products.

request.description: Lists reviews for a specific product.
Submits a review and rating for a product.

item.name: 6. Notifications
item.description: In-app account notifications, user notification preferences, outbound email logs and dynamic templates.

request.description: Lists in-app notifications for authenticated user with optional filtering by is_read, type, priority, and text search.
Quick lightweight endpoint returning unread_count and urgent_count for navbar bell icon.
Fetches complete notification details including message body, action URL, and metadata payload.
Sets is_read=true and populates read_at timestamp for a single notification.
Reverts notification is_read to false and resets read_at.
Batch marks all unread notifications of current user as read in a single atomic SQL query.
Deletes notification from user's personal alert feed.
Bulk deletes all read notifications for the current user.
Retrieves user channel opt-in/opt-out preferences.
Partially updates user notification preference flags.
Administrative overview of all notifications with advanced filters and customer search.

Manually triggers a dispatch attempt for a failed email notification.
Cancels a pending email in the dispatch queue.
Lists all dynamic notification templates.

item.name: 7. Dashboard & Admin APIs
item.description: Administrative metrics, inventory reports, and operational analytics.

request.description: Retrieves revenue, order count, and user growth statistics for admin dashboard.
